prompt.generated_prompt_string: Restore the attached old portrait into a professional DSLR-quality image with natural color and detail. Preserve the exact adult face, identity, age presentation, expression, hairstyle, jacket, sweater, crop, background, and historical character shown in the source. Repair fading, scratches, stains, noise, blur, and physical damage conservatively. Improve recoverable clarity and tonal balance while retaining realistic skin texture and original photographic mood. Do not add or remove people, alter the face or age, change clothing, replace the background, invent missing detail, or restage the photograph.
prompt.negative_prompt: identity change, face swap, age alteration, added person, removed person, invented clothing, changed background, changed pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, text alteration, deformed
